text: 上海证券交易所公布，百度A类普通股及其他53只股份获纳入沪港通下港股通标的证券，有关调整将于下周一(7日)生效。 花旗之前分析认为，如果百度获准纳入港股通，将可能成为吸引可观资金流入和买盘兴趣的关键催化剂。据第三方预测，未来2到4个月，百度净新增南向资金量或达60亿美元(约468亿港元)。
text_en: The Shanghai Stock Exchange announced that Baidu's Class A ordinary shares and 53 other stocks have been included in the southbound trading eligible securities under Stock Connect, effective Monday (Sept. 7). Citi previously noted that if Baidu is allowed into Stock Connect, it could be a key catalyst for significant capital inflows and buying interest. According to third-party forecasts, Baidu's net new southbound capital could reach $6 billion (about HK$46.8 billion) over the next 2 to 4 months.
